correctness.rationale: The dual-code identity and its rank formula are proved directly. Affine independent point sets are enumerated by an ordered product, divided by a factorial. Distinct-coordinate coupon sampling gives the complete finite distributions and exact expectation. A uniform geometric tail bound and rank-increment geometric waiting establish the full limiting law and the exact asymptotic constant for every m tending to infinity. Independent brute-force verification for m=3,4 and rational recurrences for m=3..12 support, but do not replace, the infinite proof. The script extracted from the packaged row successfully replays all tests.

originality.rationale: The novel asserted result is the complete deterministic extended-binary-Hamming full-rank stopping law and its sharp n/m expected-read benchmark correction, not the known abstract duality, random-matrix product, or Erdős–Borwein constant. value.rationale: Extended Hamming codes are canonical high-rate single-error-correcting binary codes. A complete full-information recovery time law is a natural invariant in randomized sequencing and coding. The exact finite counts and sharp asymptotic excess in the non-MDS small-alphabet regime reveal a deterministic-to-random-matrix universality relation requiring duality, independent-set enumeration and uniform-tail arguments. The specific coefficient controls a meaningful leading-order read overhead; it is not a gratuitous small-case statistic.
